title: Quarter turns
rule: Each tier is lettered in a different orientation; the reader turns the page a quarter turn per tier.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p81_quarter_turns.py (scenes: build/p46_clock_face.scene on the b1m2 cut-paper model; ring disc: films/swarm/anemic-cinema/optics.render_rings)

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: three card bands on the LoC 1934 sheet, each composed upright and laid in a different orientation: tier 1 a quarter turn anticlockwise, tier 2 upside down, tier 3 a quarter turn clockwise; no tier reads upright as the page lies

each tier: four round disc prints of the b1m2 HANDMADE cut-paper office scenes in ink (page 46's scene()), the ANRC 1922 key cutout in brass, captions in the shared pen hand, the four canon lines in cut-paper balloons

at each tier's head a turning key: the anemic-cinema O_A engraved ring disc (procedural) printed in ink, a red tier numeral on a card pin and a red cut-card arrow, lettered 'one / two / three quarter turns'
tier 2 also carries 'Now turn the page one more quarter, for the cupboard.'; the folio line stays upright ('81 / Quarter turns') and is the page's home orientation after the fourth turn

events.E0: tier 1: desk and memo, he gets up, on his way
events.E2: tier 2: looks at the clock, answer
events.E4: tier 3: on to the cupboard, he opens it, the key tagged SERVICE
events.E5: tier 3 disc 4: forgetting; caption with the outcome

beat: the page turned clockwise on the table a quarter at a time; at each stop the upright tier stays full and the others pale
beat_frames: b01 the page as it lies
b03 one quarter turn: tier 1 upright
b05 two quarter turns: tier 2 upright
b06 three quarter turns: tier 3 upright

self_check.check: Each tier reads upright only after a quarter turn.
self_check.evidence: perceptually judged by the maker from the full-size page; blind reading pending

weaknesses: three tiers (not four) so that no tier is upright before turning; the fourth turn only brings the page home
disc prints are small silhouettes (R 196-206 px); the memo slip and clock time need a close look
the ring discs at the tier heads are orientation keys, not narrative
captions beside the discs in tiers 1 and 3 read across the tier's short side in 3-4 short lines
